description: The intake record: what changed against the base, and which pipeline row that change takes. Written by `plumbline.py classify`.

base.description: The ref the change was measured against, as given or as defaulted (for example origin/main).

head.description: The full commit id of HEAD when the record was written.

merge_base.description: The full commit id of `git merge-base <base> HEAD`: where the diff starts.

files.description: Every changed file: committed, uncommitted, and untracked but not ignored (counted as added lines).

type.description: The first file type of the pipeline (repo types first) whose paths match.

generated.description: True when the path matches the pipeline's `generated` globs; such files do not count toward `lines`.

symlink.description: True when the path is a symbolic link (git mode 120000).

types.description: The distinct file types among the files, in precedence order: the first decides the row.

lines.description: Changed lines (added + removed) outside the generated files.

size.description: S, M or L, from `lines` and the pipeline's [sizes] table.

row.description: The matrix row the change takes: the deciding type, plus the size for a row split by size (for example code.M).

symlinks.description: Paths of the symbolic links among the files.

notes.description: Anything the classifier had to assume or skip.
